origins.section: Java 17 Refuses Deep Reflection into the JDK, and --illegal-access Is Gone
Spot the Problem: A Trimmed Runtime Has No Algorithms
A Generator Shared Across Threads Is Either Slow or Wrong
The Security Manager Still Compiles, Warns, and Since 18 Refuses to Install

recorded.prompt:q-illegal-access-permit: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-illegal-access-permit: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-illegal-access-permit: Section 'Java 17 Refuses Deep Reflection into the JDK, and --illegal-access Is Gone': the `--illegal-access=permit` run prints 'Ignoring option --illegal-access=permit; support was removed in 17.0' then 'InaccessibleObjectException ... module java.base does not "opens java.util"'; text: 'Java 17 removed the option (JEP 403), so the JVM ignores it with the warning above.' HashMap is in java.util, the same unopened package as the ArrayList example.
recorded.prompt:q-jlink-random: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-jlink-random: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-jlink-random: Section 'Spot the Problem: A Trimmed Runtime Has No Algorithms': 'on 21 the new algorithms live in the `jdk.random` module, found at run time through `ServiceLoader`. `jdeps` sees no reference to it, so the image ships without it, and only the legacy names resolve', with output 'IllegalArgumentException: No implementation of the random number generator algorithm ... is available'. Xoshiro256PlusPlus is listed as a non-legacy algorithm in the Reference table.
recorded.prompt:q-stored-thread-local-random: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-stored-thread-local-random: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-stored-thread-local-random: Section 'A Generator Shared Across Threads Is Either Slow or Wrong': 'The stored instance reads the calling thread's state, and a thread that never called `current()` has never had it seeded. Its numbers then depend only on the thread's id, so with the same JVM flags and CPU count they are the same after every restart.' Caveat: the page conditions this on same JVM flags and CPU count (and implicitly same thread ids); the option states it unconditionally.

recorded.pass:q-security-manager-21: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-security-manager-21: Section 'The Security Manager Still Compiles, Warns, and Since 18 Refuses to Install': 'Compiled with `--release 11`, the same source gives none' and 'Since 18 it throws, as above, unless the JVM starts with `-Djava.security.manager=allow`... A plugin host upgraded to 21 with a catch-all around that call runs its plugins with no sandbox at all.' The output shows UnsupportedOperationException (a RuntimeException).
